_description: Historical eclipse audit summary — L-5b lunar three-way comparison (267 primary-source Stephenson 2016 events, Babylonian/Greek/Chinese/Arab, -720 to 1280 CE) and L-7 solar cross-validation (89 events). Measured 2026-07-23 under the joint world (4-flag stack + Core-mantle swing; anchors then USNO 86,400.0014 / deltaTStart 56.05) via the browser console campaigns; the authoritative writeup is docs/102-gia-alpha-lunar-validation.md. Mean |residual| in seconds; NASA = Espenak/Meeus polynomial (fit to essentially this dataset, so per-event NASA residuals index fit quality against a smoothed representation, not physical validity). Consumed by the model-values registry (eclipse-audit keys); the framework-vs-NASA gap keys are DERIVED from these so a re-run flows through automatically.
